props.text: He did what he thought would bring short-term confidence to the market, and I think that's what we're seeing . By him raising some USD it means that they have a little bit more runway to pay STRC dividends but the reality is that he's still fucked like he's still gonna have to sell Bitcoin when they start running out of runway so unless the market's just gonna magically turn around and save him and get him back into the green then I still don't see how this turns out well. it was a short-term fix from my perspective.
